scene: The back wall folds away, revealing three bustling night-transit docks under neon signs.
picture: A flat side view inside the opened radio shop. On the left stands a brass night funicular cabin with its door open. The player stands beside it. At centre rests an idling multi-legged bridge crawler with gangway down. On the far right hangs an empty yellow window-cleaner gondola swaying gently.
